The root cause of the bug and its fix have been identified and verified.

### Root Cause
In [`NodeUtil.mayBeString(Node, boolean)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/closure_10_group_a_blind/src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java#L1415-L1421), when `recurse` was true, the method erroneously invoked `allResultsMatch(n, MAY_BE_STRING_PREDICATE)` instead of `anyResultsMatch(n, MAY_BE_STRING_PREDICATE)`. As a result, expressions like conditional/hook operators `(Math.random() > 0.5 ? '1' : 2)` where only one of the branches may be a string were incorrectly determined not to be strings (since not all branches were strings). This led constant folding in [`PeepholeFoldConstants.tryFoldAdd`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/closure_10_group_a_blind/src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/PeepholeFoldConstants.java#L827-L847) to incorrectly assume the addition was purely numeric and fold subsequent operations, altering runtime string-concatenation behavior.

### Fix
In [`NodeUtil.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/closure_10_group_a_blind/src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java#L1417), changed `allResultsMatch(n, MAY_BE_STRING_PREDICATE)` to `anyResultsMatch(n, MAY_BE_STRING_PREDICATE)`.

### Verification
- Ran `com.google.javascript.jscomp.PeepholeFoldConstantsTest::testIssue821` and confirmed `Failing tests: 0`.
- Generated the focused patch file [blind_fix.patch](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/closure_10_group_a_blind/blind_fix.patch).
